subject: Re: OEM Core Switching Solution
text:
Hi, Pavel,
Thanks for your reply.
1. Currently, Brocade's Ethernet switch business has been integrated into
other vendor portfolios, so most Brocade switches available on the market
today are legacy or second-hand units from inventory resellers.
2. We can source Brocade switches depending on the specific model and your
requirements (e.g., port count, speed, module type, condition — new/used).
And we do have a channel to get it.
So
Could you please let me know:
Which Brocade model(s) you're interested in?
Required port speed (e.g., 1G, 10G, 40G)?
Desired condition (new, refurbished, used)?
Thanks!
note: SA-066 CCS（俄罗斯，Павел Карпов）：他要 Brocade；Elsa 2026-01-30 答可代找二手/库存 Brocade，问型号 / 速率 / 新旧——非 Saga 产品线
